Any person who is above 18 years of age, who has filled the membership form and deposited the prescribed fee, who fully understands and accepts the objectives and principles of the party, can become a member of Sarvjan Sanatan Party.
Membership Period of Sarvjan Sanatan Party
The validity of membership of Sarvjan Sanatan Party will be for 6 years.
Format and Declaration of Membership Form
I am an Indian and a self-respecting, patriotic, follower of the sacred traditions of Sanatan.
I am not involved in any anti-religious and anti-national activities in any way.
I am not a member of any other party. I try to remain pure in thought, words and actions.
I am well acquainted with the principles of Sarvjan Sanatan Party and its rules and regulations.
If I am ever found guilty of any kind of involvement against the Sarvjan Sanatan Party or the country and Sanatan Dharma, then I should be immediately expelled from the party.
My allegiance is to Sarvjan Sanatan Party, I am determined to make the people of the country self-respecting and the country powerful.
I will follow the instructions issued by the party from time to time, and will always be ready to protect my self-respect and values.
The membership fee will be distributed among the organization in the prescribed ratio to smoothly conduct the work of party interest.
Total share of money received from the entire nation - membership fee:

First of all, the entire membership fee will be deposited in the provincial office, which will immediately be sent to the central office. The amount will be deposited in all the treasuries only by the central leadership.
